top.title: Flurry of Diplomacy in Iran Amid Reports of U.S. and Israeli Plans to Renew War
top.summary: A rare joint visit to Tehran is expected by Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan amid reports that the U.S. and Israel are drawing up plans to renew their war on Iran.
